coordinateSystem.grid: authoritative oriented native source pixel edges
coordinateSystem.cropBounds: integer left/top inclusive; right/bottom exclusive; no resampling
coordinateSystem.radialCoverage: Let q be the source-pixel delta rotated by minus rotationDegrees, divided componentwise by radiusPx. For d=length(q), coverage is 1-smoothstep(1-featherPercent/100,1,d). Zero feather selects d<=1 exactly.
coordinateSystem.applicationMapping: Existing radial MaskGradient: center.x=centerPx.x/width, center.y=centerPx.y/height, radiusX=radiusPx.x/width, radiusY=radiusPx.y/height, rotation=rotationDegrees, feather=featherPercent. No additional Feather/Expand, strokes, inversion or operands.
coordinateSystem.partialManualRegions: These deliberately partial analytic regions are not object segmentations, recovered feather coverage, physical alpha or full subject masks. Neighborhood filtering may read outside them; final blending uses their coverage.

selectionPolicy.basis: Unchanged original plus source-only native crops; no Texture candidate or filtered output was viewed.
selectionPolicy.afterOutputChanges: Do not move masks/crops, change feather/support, substitute sources or remove unfavorable controls after candidate output. Any revision requires a separately versioned protocol and retained original evidence.
selectionPolicy.amounts: Candidate amounts and independent per-mask strength assignments belong to the separately frozen research protocol, not this source-selection manifest.
selectionPolicy.unaffectedControlStage: Exact comparisons apply to native linear working pixels before rendition, resize and lossy encoding, against the matching neutral/existing pipeline. Final resized/JPEG pixels are not an exact-zero-coverage oracle.
selectionPolicy.conditionalSupplements: Supplemental cases below are inactive unless selected prospectively in the protocol; they must not trigger a second method, parameter sweep or automatic extra full-source work.

cases.domain: authored SDR sRGB JPEG; native decoding/color management determines linear working samples
cases.credit: Elgollimoh, Flamant rose Salines de Thyna.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0.
cases.derivedOutputNotice: Retain Elgollimoh credit, source/license links, a description of filtering/cropping/annotations and applicable CC BY-SA 3.0 terms. Keep generated images outside Git.
cases.privacyReview: Retained fixture manifest records complete original, both embedded previews and all 278 metadata tags reviewed on 2026-11-10; no personal information found. Source bytes remain unchanged.
limitations: Processed published SDR JPEG; not camera-original RAW, radiometric truth or true HDR acceptance.
Reflected legs are visible; a complete reflected bird, human skin and foliage are absent.
The local crop of ripples includes existing soft horizontal reflected color, visible grain and small floating dark objects; these are source content, not candidate artifacts.
Manual regions are intentionally partial and do not qualify automatic selection, image-guided Refine Edge or complete subject isolation.
cases.maskOrderMeaning: Top-first list; apply bottom-to-top like the application. Outer supports are disjoint, so this particular photographic case does not establish overlapping-mask order correctness.

masks.label: Partial wing plumage
masks.purpose: Long pale/coral feathers and their existing fine striations; excludes most of the bird, its neck and all legs.

masks.label: Partial ripple patch beside reflection
masks.purpose: A small horizontal ripple/reflected-color patch to the right of the legs, with nearby smooth water left unmasked. It is not the full ripple field.

masks.label: Partial reflected-leg area
masks.purpose: Part of both wavy reflected legs and water between them, independently controlled from real legs, plumage and the neighboring ripple patch. Surrounding water inside the ellipse is intentionally included.

regions.name: plumage-native
regions.purpose: Feather striations, existing soft feather contours and the upper silhouette/smooth background near a partial manual mask.

regions.name: ripples-native
regions.purpose: Selected ripple patch near the bottom alongside a substantial unmasked smooth-water control area.

regions.name: reflected-legs-native
regions.purpose: Wavy reflected contours, water between them and the leftmost edge of the separately selected ripple patch.

unaffectedControls.name: distant-smooth-water
unaffectedControls.purpose: Smooth native water/background away from all selected regions.

unaffectedControls.name: unmasked-feathers
unaffectedControls.purpose: Feathers elsewhere on the same bird must not acquire the partial wing mask's Texture strength.

unaffectedControls.name: water-beside-reflection
unaffectedControls.purpose: Nearby water remains outside both the reflected-leg and ripple supports.

unaffectedControls.name: water-outside-ripple-patch
unaffectedControls.purpose: Water next to the small selected ripple patch, outside all manual mask supports.

conditionalSupplementalCases.activation: Only if prospectively selected to assess negative Texture or positive-strength grain after the primary proof; no automatic additional run.

conditionalSupplementalCases.limitations: Reviewed anonymous skin/body hair, processed SDR JPEG; not face/scalp hair, RAW, paired clean/noisy truth or HDR acceptance. No Texture masks are frozen for this inactive case.
